subject.title: Feature Request: Support YAML as config file format

question: Should OpenClaw add `.yaml`/`.yml` as supported core config files, or keep JSON5 `openclaw.json` plus CLI/RPC config mutation as the only core config-file contract?
rationale: This changes the compatibility-sensitive core config-file contract, including path precedence, parser semantics, persistence format, reload behavior, docs, and doctor expectations; automation should not choose that policy.

options.title: Keep JSON5 Canonical
options.body: Reaffirm `openclaw.json` as the only core config file and steer scripted edits through `openclaw config`, `config.patch`, and docs for comment-aware mutation.

options.title: Approve YAML Contract
options.body: Require a design and PR that defines `.yaml`/`.yml` precedence, parser behavior, write-back policy, hot reload, doctor handling, docs, and upgrade tests.

recommendation.title: Keep JSON5 Canonical
recommendation.body: Reaffirm `openclaw.json` as the only core config file and steer scripted edits through `openclaw config`, `config.patch`, and docs for comment-aware mutation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent config IO/docs history and is the strongest product-policy routing candidate for a core config contract decision.
